findings.title: Reconstructed line loops are never recognized as closed
findings.body: BuildLoops returns an ordered list of edges, but this conversion retains only each edge's start point. The final point is therefore the start of the closing edge rather than the loop's initial point. ProcessPoints requires its first and last points to coincide, so every rectangle assembled from separate CAD Line objects is rejected. Append the final edge's endpoint, or change ProcessPoints to accept an implicitly closed ordered loop.

findings.title: CAD instance transform is applied twice
findings.body: Traversal starts with cadLink.GetTotalTransform(), then multiplies by each GeometryInstance.Transform while reading symbol geometry. The top-level geometry instance already supplies the import/link instance transformation, so a moved, rotated, or scaled CAD instance has that transformation applied twice. Extracted centers, dimensions, and rotations will consequently be wrong. Start symbol-geometry traversal from Transform.Identity, or use instance geometry with one explicitly defined transformation path.
